topic: The Physics of Refractive Index: Origins and Chromatic Dependence

sections.title: Introduction: The 'Slow-Motion' Illusion
lecture_lines: Light enters media and seems to slow down.
Refractive index n equals speed of light over velocity.
n greater than one means light slows.

sections.title: Visualizing the Mathematics: The Sellmeier Equation
lecture_lines: The Sellmeier equation describes material response.
Refractive index depends on wavelength constants.
Values peak near material absorption bands.
Prisms reveal this through color spreading.

sections.title: Conclusion and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Dispersion stems from varying resonance strengths.
Optical designs must account for this.
